title: RV & Boat Storage: Limit on Spaces per Household
content:
A household may rent at most two RV & Boat Storage spaces at a time across the storage yard of its community.

**The rule the desk applies.** A new storage reservation is taken only when the customer has fewer than two storage rentals in reserved, active, past-due lockout or notice-to-vacate status. The count is taken from the customer's storage rentals as they stand on the handling date; a rental in closed status is not one of the counted statuses.

**Condition — judgement — result**

- Condition: the number of the customer's storage rentals that are reserved, active, in past-due lockout or under notice to vacate on the handling date.
- Judgement: is that number fewer than two?
- Result: if it is, a reservation may be taken; if it is not, a reservation is not taken.

**Judgement table (hypothetical holdings)**

| Customer's storage rentals on the handling date | Counted rentals | Fewer than two? | New reservation |
|---|---|---|---|
| none, or only closed rentals | 0 | yes | taken |
| one active rental | 1 | yes | taken |
| one active rental and one closed rental | 1 | yes | taken |
| one reserved rental | 1 | yes | taken |
| one active rental and one in past-due lockout | 2 | no | not taken |
| one active rental and one under notice to vacate | 2 | no | not taken |
| one active rental and one reserved rental | 2 | no | not taken |

**Basis Q&A**

*Does a space that is only reserved, with no unit moved in yet, count toward the two?* Yes. Reserved status is one of the counted statuses.

*Does a space whose gate access is suspended for unpaid rent count?* Yes. Past-due lockout is one of the counted statuses.

*Does a space the customer has given notice to vacate still count?* Yes, while it is under notice to vacate; it stops counting once the rental is closed.
